title: [maintainer] refactor(app-shell): move Studio's flow rail helpers, pillar kit and Data pillar helpers out of StudioDesignSurface.tsx (slice 4, final: file under 10,000 lines)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBCE4YXYCrA6G1yrthEDVvNJ)_

Fixes #29988

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 Studio 三组辅助代码原样搬进同目录三个新文件——自动化栏的流程辅助(347 行)进 `AutomationsFlowRail.tsx`,各支柱共用的工具集(335 行)进 `StudioPillarKit.tsx`,数据支柱的辅助(181 行)进 `DataPillarHelpers.tsx`;主文件 10,757 → **9,928 行**,低于 1 万,本卡完成。
- 为什么改:#29988 按裁定 #24586 A 只搬不改,把这个文件拆到 1 万行以下;维护者问 1,000 行一片是否值得,席位决定最后一片合并接缝表第 4–6 行一次做完。第 7–10 行(整个支柱组件)不搬,留给以后的卡。
- 风险与回滚:无行为变化,八段搬走的代码逐字节一致,只多了 import 和 `export`;原来从 `StudioDesignSurface` 导出的五个名字在原处重新导出,所有引用照常工作;对外导出摘要两边一致(只是类型的声明文件变了);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:三个新文件的 import 段;`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 import 段和三行重新导出;`studio-authoring.json` 四处出处改动与新加的 history 行。
- 两分钟验证:在本分支跑下方「Verification」里的 `cmp` 命令组,预期全部无输出(逐字节相同)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Seam table

Carried forward from #30014. Base lines below are at `origin/main` `9d1a465f0` (this PR's base, after slice 3), where `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is 10,757 lines. "Left" is the file's line count after that row and every row above it, measured at this PR's commits.

Rows 4–6 now live outside the file, so a later card can move rows 7–10 without an import cycle back into it.

## What changes

One commit per seam row, then one for the readers and the checklist.

- **Row 4 → `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/AutomationsFlowRail.tsx` (new)**: base lines 7614–7960, byte for byte, under a copyright line, a module comment and the imports the block reads. `export` is added on the 18 names the rest of the file reads (`FlowRuntimeState`, `FlowRailState`, `flowRailState`, `flowRailStatus`, `flowDotClass`, `FLOW_GLYPH_ICON`, `FLOW_GLYPH_LABEL_KEY`, `NO_OBJECT_GROUP_KEY`, `readFlowRegistrations`, `readFlowDefinitions`, `readObjectLabels`, `newFlowTriggerFields`, `withStartTrigger`, `NO_OBJECT_ORDER`, `FlowCopiedStrip`, `FLOW_COPIED_ARRIVAL_STATE`, `pairIdOf`, `readFlowCopiedArrival`). `FlowStatusDot` and `NewFlowTrigger` were already exported, keep their `export`, and are re-exported from `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. The one-line section comment above the block at 7613 (`/** Automations pillar — flows: … */`) heads `AutomationsPillar` and stays.
- **Row 6 → `DataPillarHelpers.tsx` (new)**: base lines 443–460, 5135–5202 and 5281–5375, byte for byte; `export` on the 13 names `DataPillar` reads. **`renderStudioGridList` (5204–5279) stays in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`.** It carries `// eslint-disable-next-line react-refresh/only-export-components`, and in a module that exports no component that line is an unused directive, which this repo's eslint reports as an error (measured on the first cut). Moving it would need that line edited or dropped, which is not a move, and the file is under 10,000 lines without it.
- **Row 5 → `StudioPillarKit.tsx` (new)**: base lines 504–643, 663–751 (the "Show me" section comment at 663–671 and its helpers), 764–843 and 2233–2258, byte for byte; `export` on the 7 names the rest of the file reads (`useHeldEditReport`, `confirmDropUnsavedWork`, `findTakenIdentifier`, `CreateTakenNotice`, `useShowInputFocus`, `StudioSavedDraft`, `announceDraftSaved`). `StudioHeldNotice`, `StudioReadOnlyLink` and `StudioBaseCustomization` were already exported and are re-exported from `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`.
- **`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`**: the eight blocks are gone. It imports the names from the three modules beside the slice 3 import, re-exports the five names it exported before in two lines with a comment each (where their first block was), and drops the import bindings only the moved code used (`describeFlowRunStatus`, `FlowRunStatusView`, `FlowRuntimeRow`, `fieldsForNodeType`, `localizeFlowFields`, `FlowConfigField`, `Zap`, `Clock`, `MousePointerClick`, `CornerDownRight`, `FlowTriggerGlyph`, `customizationPackageId`, `SpecFlowRuntimeState`, `romanizeHan`, `toFieldNameLoose`, `PackageCustomizationsState`, `useStudioTabRowFold`).
- **Importers through `./StudioDesignSurface` are unchanged**, by the re-exports: `FlowStatusDot.test.tsx`, `FlowStatusDot.registration-12349.test.tsx`, `StudioReadOnlyLink.overlay-27356.test.tsx`, the five tests that import `type StudioBaseCustomization`, and the two source files `StudioBundleItemEditor.tsx` and `StudioMetadataArea.tsx` (type-only imports, so no runtime cycle). `StudioDesignSurface.gridRefresh.test.tsx` imports `renderStudioGridList`, which did not move.
- **By-path readers** (ruling 6597555122 item 3): `homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373.test.ts`'s Studio site `alsoReads` and `spec-symbol-ledger-app-shell-7265.test.ts`'s `SITES` each gain the three modules. The ledger's `FlowRuntimeState` site (`type FlowRuntimeState = Partial<SpecFlowRuntimeState>`) now lives in `AutomationsFlowRail.tsx`.
- **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`**, source re-points only, each with a revision bump and a history row ("No clause changed"):
  - `held-edit-leave-guard` r5 → r6: `confirmDropUnsavedWork` and `useHeldEditReport` now cited in `StudioPillarKit.tsx`; the rest stays on `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`.
  - `automations-rail-and-new-flow` r2 → r3: `FLOW_GLYPH_ICON` / `FLOW_GLYPH_LABEL_KEY`, `flowDotClass`, `FlowStatusDot` now cited in `AutomationsFlowRail.tsx`; the rail legend and the New automation presets stay.
  - `flow-status-matches-runtime` r2 → r3: `FlowStatusDot` and `flowRailStatus` now cited in `AutomationsFlowRail.tsx`.
  - `access-permission-set-lifecycle` r7 → r8: `findTakenIdentifier` and `CreateTakenNotice` now cited in `StudioPillarKit.tsx`; the Access pillar's use of them stays.
- `.changeset/29988-studio-pillar-helpers-modules.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, "internal: move-only".

## Tests

No behaviour changes, so no new behaviour test. The existing suites run unchanged; results are in Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **The bar is met**: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is 9,928 lines at this head (`wc -l`), so this PR says `Fixes #29988`.
- **No fallback trigger hit**: no import cycle (the three modules import nothing from `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`; the two source files that import a moved type through it do so type-only), no census row to re-key (`clickableNonControlCensus-13461`'s rows for this file are `DataPillar` and `StudioDesignSurfaceBody` handlers, which stay; the moved clicks are `<button>`s), and 1,941 changed lines in all, under 3,000.
- **Readers re-grepped.** `git grep` of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` / `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface` over `scripts/**`, `ui/scripts/**` and every ui test file finds the same two whole-text readers as before; both gained the three modules. The directory walkers (`noRetiredSetupLink-28578`, `noSetupMetadataLink-28578`, `CreateItemDialog.oneLabel-11787`) and `clickableNonControlCensus-13461` walk the tree themselves. `openPathObjectReaders-12811` classifies readers of `useMetadata().objects`; none of the moved code reads it.
- **Checklist rows re-read.** Every `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` citation under `docs/qa/` was read against the moved names: the four above named moved helpers, and the rest cite pillar logic that stays (`railPairId`, `ledgerRow`, `openCreateFlow`, `openCreateSet`, `heldEdit`, `unsavedPillarWork`, each still in the file).
- **Comments that name the file for moved text, left as they are** (outside the file surface): `spec-symbol-parity.test.ts` says "`StudioDesignSurface` declares `type FlowRuntimeState = …`" (now in `AutomationsFlowRail.tsx`; the test pins the types, not the file).
- **Serial check.** No open PR touched `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the three new modules, either extended reader or `studio-authoring.json` when the seat claimed (round 4 Claim) or right before this push (see Verification). The branch was restarted from `origin/main` after #30014 merged and is rebased on `63b86b38`, which touches only `packages/rest/` and its changeset.

<details><summary>Declaration files (ruling 6348891160's bar)</summary>

Base declarations emitted from the base source into a scratch `outDir` under the lock, tree restored (`git diff HEAD` empty). Of the 702 base `.d.ts` files, 699 are byte-identical at head. The three that differ:

- `chrome/ErrorBoundary.d.ts` and `console/ai/outboundAgentText.d.ts`: the members of one union print in another order (`render()`'s return union; `Record<"en" | "zh", string>` against `Record<"zh" | "en", string>`), program-order type creation; with union members sorted (the ruling's normalisation) each pair is identical.
- `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.d.ts` (base sha256 `d0f9665b1e9ed6fc…`): the moved declarations now come from the three new `.d.ts` files, and the five names it exported before are re-exported (`export { FlowStatusDot, type NewFlowTrigger }`, `export { StudioHeldNotice, StudioReadOnlyLink, type StudioBaseCustomization }`). Every declaration chunk of the base file appears verbatim in the head file or in one of `AutomationsFlowRail.d.ts`, `StudioPillarKit.d.ts`, `DataPillarHelpers.d.ts`; the one chunk that does not is the file's header comment with its import block, whose import lines are what changed.

The three new `.d.ts` / `.js` pairs are reachable from no entry in the package's `exports` map (`"."` only). Declared-surface digest of `dist/index.d.ts` plus `StudioDesignSurface.d.ts`: 245 exports on both sides. Read with the declaring file of a type masked (the printer qualifies `StudioBaseCustomization`, `StudioSavedDraft`, `FlowRailState` and `NewFlowTrigger` by the file that declares them, which is now the new module), the two dumps are identical (`6e1f795576824163…`); unmasked, they differ in exactly those 7 qualified names.
</details>
